description: A Hundred Counters (백 번의 반격): a long sword and a short parrying blade crossed, a ring of many small silver arcs around them like blows turned aside.
Lion Strike (사자의 일격): a heavy black-iron lance head striking down with a lion-shaped plume of dark smoke behind it (no emblem).
Lion's Roar (사자의 포효): a dark lion-shaped wave of sound rolling outward in rings over a small plain shield, binding chains of light at its edge.
Lion Banner (사자의 깃발): a black banner with a plain gold border on a lance, its cloth spread like a shelter over two small plain shields.
The Black Lion's Resolve (검은 사자의 결의): a black-armoured rider's lance thrust in a full circle, a ring of broken arrows and a dark gold glow around it.

name_en: The Seal of the Three Houses
description: The Seal of the Three Houses (세 왕가의 인장): three small wax seals in slate-blue, moss-green and flame-red pressed side by side on one pale ribbon (no symbols on the seals).
The Black Mane (검은 갈기): a braided lock of thick black horse mane bound with a plain gold ring, a faint warm glow.
